n.story:
Your role is transforming from a field surveyor into a landscape-scale ecosystem architect. The days of manual herbicide application and tedious seedling counts are being replaced by autonomous drones and satellite-linked AI. These tools now handle the 'brute force' data collection and vegetation control, allowing you to step into a more strategic role. You no longer just walk the woods; you manage the digital twin of the forest.

With AI amplifying your understanding of forest ecology and fire behavior, you can model the impact of a thinning operation or a reforestation plan decades into the future. You spend your time interpreting complex LiDAR maps to identify specific trees for removal, ensuring optimal forest health while maximizing timber value. Your physical presence is now reserved for high-value problem solving, emergency response, and supervising the robotic systems that maintain the forest's edge.
